name: Fading Elysium
source:
Welcome to Magnurs! An idyllic kingdom of festivals, fun, food, and wonderment. Thanks to its incredible technological advancements, it's truly become a heaven on earth!

And so to this glittering world an Ambassador is summoned, who seeks only that which is just and fair. But to achieve his goals, he must carefully play his part in the performance he has unwittingly joined. 

For surely, a country of such wonderful people would be more than happy to help set things right. Wouldn't they?

...wouldn't they?

So dive in, stay alert, and with a bit of digging, you're bound to find the root of this international drama.

[From [url=https://alsler.itch.io/fading-elysium]Itch.io[/url]]
